main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: From Material Prison to Pleroma of Light
header_desc: This work represents the integration of the spiritual knowledge of the 1st century backed by 21st-century science, allowing us to answer the fundamental question about who we are in the Universe. The ego bends our space-time: matter is an emergent property of our psyche, so the timeless plane of the cosmos is intimately linked to the pneuma, thus revealing that we harbor within us that divine ❤️ spark ✝️.
left_body: The solution to one of the great pillars of modern physics — quantum gravity — finds its key in texts written almost two millennia ago: the Gnostic gospels. In this plane, consciousness manifests through the states | ONE ⟩ and | EGO ⟩, revealing that we possess true free will of perception, mathematically formalized through the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. Space-time tells matter how to move and matter tells space-time how to curve; thus, possessed by the mass and density of a deforming ego, getting rid of it is equivalent to freeing ourselves from that earthly gravity to return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father: The One.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly there is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is no point in praying to the law of gravity.
universe_light_text: The Father and I are one: Remembering who you are — the revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist — frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The division of consciousness between the timeless light of divine feeling and the temporal density of material thought.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and the entire humanity will heal.
